calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Mar-01-2007 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Clifford Wang, Esq. for Petitioners: Hui Qing Liang and Wei Xiong Huang, present as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Yong Hui Hung, were sworn and examined.
Mr. Wang is also serve as a Cantonese Interpreter for the Petitioners, parties and Interpreter were sworn and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of the Minor to: Tim Yong Hui Huang.
Decree signed in open court.
